live_twin_run.twin_topology:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ceragon functional twin - metro aggregation ring (mixed portfolio)
#   IP-50EX Multi-Band trunk (E-band + 18 GHz, 1+1 HSB), IP-50FX XPIC ring hops,
#   IP-20C green tail, EtherHaul E-band spur with MACsec, MultiHaul TG access.
#   A "site" node can host several radios: use model= on the link line.
# Run:
#   ./ns3 run "ceragon-twin-from-file --topology=contrib/ceragon/examples/topologies/metro-ring.twin --simTime=12"
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# name     model      x(m)    y(m)
node dc     host       -50     0
node hubA   site        0      0
node hubB   site       2800    0
node hubC   site       2800   4000
node hubD   site        0     4000
node tailC  IP-20C     8000   4000
node ehHub  EH-8010FX  2810   20
node ehSpur EH-8010FX  2800   1800
node pop    MH-N366    3000   1810
node cn1    MH-T261    3150   1900
node cn2    MH-T265    3120   1680
node cell1  host       8050   4000
node fwa1   host       3200   1950

wire dc hubA rate=25Gbps
link hubA hubB model=IP-50EX distance=2800 protection=hsb sync=bc
link hubB hubC model=IP-50FX distance=4000 sync=bc
link hubC hubD model=IP-50FX distance=2800 sync=bc
link hubD hubA model=IP-50FX distance=4000
link hubC tailC model=IP-20C distance=5200 atpc=1 rsl=-45 sleep=1
wire hubB ehHub rate=10Gbps
link ehHub ehSpur distance=1780 macsec=1
wire ehSpur pop rate=10Gbps
link pop cn1 distance=170
link pop cn2 distance=180
wire tailC cell1 rate=10Gbps
wire cn1 fwa1 rate=1Gbps

# transport slice on the trunk (CoS 5 = video slice capped at 1 Gb/s)
slice hubA hubB 5 1Gbps dscp=34,36 weight=4
# 802.1Qbv express window for fronthaul on the tail hop
tsn hubC tailC 500 250 express_mask=0x80

# services
flow fronthaul dc cell1 25Mbps  dscp=46 start=0.5
flow video     dc cell1 35Mbps  dscp=34 start=0.5
flow fwa       dc fwa1  20Mbps  dscp=0  start=0.5
flow bulk      dc ehSpur 50Mbps dscp=0  start=1.0

# weather: storm crossing the ring
rain 3 6 110

# operator / intent actions
event 7.0 hubA hubB fail-unit 0
event 8.0 pop cn1 pole-sway 2
event 9.0 hubC tailC min-mod 64QAM
event 10.0 hubA hubB restore-unit 0
